feeds.title: WWF News
feeds.description: Founded in 1967, World Wildlife Fund Canada is the country's largest international conservation organization, with the active support of hundreds of thousands of Canadians. Read the latest conservation news, stories, and reports from WWF-Canada.

feeds.title: Canadian Wildlife Federation Blog
feeds.description: Your Connection to Wildlife. The Canadian Wildlife Federation's mission is to conserve and inspire the conservation of Canada's wildlife and habitats for the use and enjoyment of all.

feeds.title: Nature Canada Blog
feeds.description: Your voice for nature! Our mission is to protect and conserve wildlife and their habitats in Canada by engaging people and advocating on behalf of nature.

feeds.title: Skedaddle Humane Wildlife Control Blog
feeds.description: Check out blog posts to know more about wildlife control and removal. Skedaddle Humane Wildlife Control was founded in 1989 with the goal of providing homeowners humane and effective solutions to wildlife conflicts.

feeds.title: Credit Valley Conservation » Nature and Wildlife
feeds.description: The Nature and Wildlife section on the blog features articles on variety of wildlife in Ontario, Canada. CVC is a community-based environmental organization dedicated to conserving, restoring, developing and managing natural resources.

feeds.title: Birds Canada Blog
feeds.description: We are your voice for birds. Our mission is to conserve wild birds through sound science, on-the-ground actions, innovative partnerships, public engagement, and science-based advocacy.

feeds.title: OFNC Blog
feeds.description: The blog features articles on conservation, news, wildlife, research etc. OFNC stands for Ottawa Field-Naturalists Club and it is the oldest natural history club in Canada. The club focuses on many aspects of the natural world, from birding to botanizing, investigation to publication, conservation to cooperation.

feeds.title: Alberta Institute For Wildlife Conservation Blog
feeds.description: Alberta Institute for Wildlife Conservation is a trusted Canadian-registered charity and are permitted by federal and provincial governments to care for wildlife in need.

feeds.title: Healthy Wildlife Blog
feeds.description: The blog of the Canadian Wildlife Health Cooperative.The purpose of this new CCWHC initiative is to deliver relevant wildlife-health related information to the general public.

feeds.title: Atlas Pest Blog
feeds.description: Atlas Pest and Wildlife Control is an industry leader in Metro Vancouver. They take pride in our hard work and our guarantee that we will get the job done no matter what pest problem you face. Their commitment to giving the best and being the best for each client is not just important but is the foundation of every employee at Atlas Pest and Wildlife Control. The blog features articles on pest and wildlife control tips.

feeds.title: Habitat Conservation Trust Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The Habitat Conservation Trust Foundation (HCTF) is a non-profit charitable, environmental granting organization in British Columbia which funds for fish, wildlife and habitat projects.

feeds.title: Wildlife Haven Rehabilitation Centre Blog
feeds.description: Educating about awareness, appreciation and peaceful coexistence with wildlife. Wildlife Haven Rehabilitation Centre has been rehabilitating injured, sick and orphaned wildlife for their return to the wild since 1984.

feeds.title: Ottawa-Carleton Wildlife Centre - Blog
feeds.description: Join the OCWC's adventures by seeing what's new, event updates, and more!The Ottawa-Carleton Wildlife Centre is wildlife's voice and helping people live in harmony with nature for over 30 years.

feeds.title: Ontario Wildlife Removal Blog
feeds.description: Ontario Wildlife Removal blog is where you will find interesting articles related to various wildlife, its removal and other news and updates etc. Ontario Wildlife Removal Inc. provides wildlife removal, animal control and pest prevention.

feeds.title: Manitoba Important Bird Areas Program Blog
feeds.description: Manitoba Important Bird Areas Program provides an opportunity to engage with, and learn about programs which are committed to the stewardship and monitoring of Manitoba's wild birds.

feeds.title: Toronto Wildlife Centre Blog
feeds.description: Toronto Wildlife Centre promotes the peaceful coexistence of people and wildlife by providing education and expert advice about wildlife situations and providing medical care to sick, injured, and orphaned wild animals with the ultimate goal of releasing healthy animals back into the wild.

feeds.title: Regional Wildlife Services Blog
feeds.description: Wildlife removal tips from the experts at Regional Wildlife serving Burlington, Oakville, Milton and area. Regional Wildlife Services is a professional wildlife removal service with over 10 years of experience.

feeds.title: Wildlife Preservation Canada Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Wildlife Preservation Canada Blog. Read all the news, articles, and blogs about the animals who are on the brink of extinction, and also take a step further to raise funds in order to save the children of nature! Our sole mission is to save animal species at risk of extinction in Canada by providing direct, hands-on care.

feeds.title: Canadian Youth Biodiversity Network Blog
feeds.description: The Canadian Youth Biodiversity Network (CYBN) aims to be a networking platform connecting youth all over Canada to work on the common goal of biodiversity and wildlife conservation.

feeds.title: Northwoods Press » Canadian Wildlife
feeds.description: The Canadian Wildlife section in the Northwoods press features everything related to Canada's wildlife. Donna Ward the author of Northwoods press is the source for exciting, authentic Canadian social studies, history, geography, and living books.

feeds.title: The Land Between
feeds.description: Cottage Country's Consevation Organization. Working to Research, Conserve & Celebrate (Educate and Communicate) the unique ecological, natural, cultural & socio-economic features of a special region in Ontario.

feeds.title: SOS Wildlife Control Blog
feeds.description: We are professionals in wildlife removal and pest control serving Toronto and the GTA.

feeds.title: Biodiversity Education & Awareness Network Blog
feeds.description: Biodiversity Education & Awareness Network (BEAN) is an Ontario based group working to increase understanding of biodiversity and & wildlife and what we can do to conserve it.

feeds.title: Bad Company Wildlife Eviction Blog
feeds.description: Bad Company Wildlife are eviction and wildlife removal specialists in the Ontario region of Canada.

feeds.title: The Fur-Bearers Blog
feeds.description: Established in 1953, The Fur-Bearers is a charitable, non-partisan organization whose goals are to end the commercial fur trade and promote solutions for wildlife coexistence in communities.

feeds.title: Heritage Wildlife Management Blog
feeds.description: Heritage Wildlife Management is a locally owned family run animal control business right here in Ottawa.

feeds.title: Ottawa Valley Wild Bird Care Centre
feeds.description: The Wild Bird Care Centre is a registered charitable organization dedicated to the care, treatment and rehabilitation of injured, ill and orphaned wild birds.
